lema: A wall proves itself when exposed to fire.
aviso_curto: Research prototype. Do not use in production. This demonstration does not prove security.
heroi_alt: Pixel-art illustration: dunes at sunset and a stone wall with a horseshoe-arch gate, towers with blue flags and a building with 32 lit and unlit windows.
heroi_sub: Cryptanalysis laboratory for RSD-S v5.2, an experimental symmetric primitive. Flip a bit, fire a probe, check every value.
oq_p1: RSD-S mixes a 512-bit state, made of 32 words of 16 bits, over 8 rounds. Each round applies an inversion S-box over GF(2^16), a 32×32 Cauchy MDS matrix and a round key derived with HMAC-SHA-256.
oq_p2: This site runs the reference implementation in your browser, checked bit for bit against the repository's Python and C core. What you see on screen is computed, not drawn.
oq_p3: Each colored block is a 16-bit word, shown as four glyphs, one per hexadecimal digit. The value is always shown as text as well.
oq_nao: It is not a cipher, not a standard and not a replacement for AES, ChaCha20 or SHA-2. It is a research object meant to be attacked.
rodada_titulo: One bit changes. How much changes after one round?
rodada_intro: Two identical executions, except for a single bit of x (x = 1 against x = 0, y = 2, key with bytes 00 to 1f, session 1). Blocks with a golden frame and the Δ sign are the ones that differ.
rodada_momento: State after round 1 of the 8-round execution
rodada_resultado: After round 1, {palavras} of 32 words and {bits} of 512 bits differ.
rodada_nota: Full diffusion in one round is not security. The beam mission in the laboratory shows an attack that still distinguishes 2 rounds. That is why the primitive has 8.
rodada_fonte: Computed right now by the reference engine (the same code that runs in the laboratory) and checked against Python in the repository tests.
rodada_cta: Redo it in the laboratory, with your own values
gar_titulo: What exists and what does not exist yet
gar_e3: Conditional draft, written for v5.1 and not yet updated to v5.2. It does not certify post-quantum security.
gar_e4: 9 findings. The 2 High and 3 Medium were fixed in v5.2. The 4 Low were not fixed, and 1 remains open.
corr_intro: The offensive review of v5.1 found 5 High and Medium severity flaws. The proof below runs the same exploit, written against v5.1, on the v5.1 code and on v5.2.
corr_baixos: The 4 Low severity findings were not fixed. RT-F2-06, leftover data in AVX2 registers, remains open.

atq_titulo: Attacks that work on few rounds
atq_intro: With few rounds, structural attacks work, and this project shows them. The table below is the XOR sum of the 32 outputs over 65,536 inputs where only one word varies (integral attack), on reduced instances with a random key.
atq_col_p: Words with a non-zero sum (out of 32)
atq_distingue: Yes: structure visible without knowing the key
atq_nota: A zero sum in 32 of 32 words would have probability 2^-512 by chance. This probe proves nothing about the others: the project has no independent audit.
atq_rec: With the pre-hash output observable, the same principle recovers the 512 bits of the equivalent 3-round subkey with 131,072 chosen plaintexts, in about 10 seconds. With 4 rounds the property disappears, and the public API hides the pre-hash state.
atq_cta: Fire the probe in the laboratory
alc_intro: Largest number of rounds at which each automated attack of the same harness still detects something. Filled cells detect; empty cells do not.
alc_nao_mostra_t: What this table does not show
alc_nao_mostra: Reach measures what this harness of 5 automated attacks detects, not security. AES has over 25 years of public cryptanalysis, attacks stronger than the harness and hardware acceleration. RSD-S has 8 rounds and no external review. Fewer detectable rounds may mean faster diffusion, not greater security.

titulo_inicio: BaSingSe: cryptanalysis laboratory for RSD-S v5.2
descricao_inicio: Cryptanalysis laboratory for RSD-S v5.2, an experimental symmetric primitive. Run it in the browser, fire probes and check every value. Research prototype, not audited.
descricao_lab: Flip a bit, fire the mirror beam, test the two sentinels and check the reference vectors. Everything is computed in the browser by the RSD-S v5.2 engine.
